description: Text as a clean mesh with extrusion, bevel, materials and export-ready UVs.

interface.description: Up to four lines; empty lines are skipped.
interface.name: Text

interface.description: Vertical alignment of the text block.
interface.name: Align Y

interface.description: What happens when the text does not fit the box.
interface.name: Overflow

interface.description: Edges above this angle (degrees) stay sharp.
interface.name: Smooth Angle

interface.description: Bevel width, at most half the depth.
interface.name: Bevel Width

interface.description: Also used for the back face.
interface.name: Front Material

interface.description: UV map 'UVMap': planar caps, sides and bevel along the outline.
interface.name: UV

interface.description: Scale the caps into 0..1; off = Blender units (tileable).
interface.name: Normalize to Text

interface.description: A rounded base plate behind the text.
interface.name: Plate

interface.description: Size the plate from the text bounds plus the margins.
interface.name: Fit to Text

interface.description: Space between plate and text back; negative sinks the text into the plate.
interface.name: Gap

interface.description: The plate top rises around the letters.
interface.name: Relief

interface.description: Subdivision levels of the plate top.
interface.name: Relief Detail

interface.description: Per-letter animation driven by the scene frame.
interface.name: Animate

interface.description: Frame at which the first element starts.
interface.name: Start

interface.description: Play once, repeat, or go back and forth.
interface.name: Loop

interface.description: In: from the start state into place. Out: from place away.
interface.name: Direction

interface.description: Where an element starts, relative to its place.
interface.name: Offset

interface.description: Rotation and scale centre: glyph pivot, word, line or text.
interface.name: Center

interface.description: Elements are invisible until they start.
interface.name: Hide Before Start

interface.description: Continuous wobble, independent of the timing.
interface.name: Bounce

interface.description: Remove points whose direction changes less than this angle (degrees). 0 = off.
interface.name: Simplify

interface.description: N-gons or triangles on the caps.
interface.name: Fill Mode

interface.description: Even-Odd or Non-Zero for overlapping outlines.
interface.name: Fill Rule

interface.description: Keep the et_* attributes (character, word, line index, pivot, weight) on the mesh.
interface.name: Keep Helper Attributes

name: ET Text Mesh
